reason: My WhatsApp routine with clients already works, and everything has to land in Jurnal or Accurate anyway. A Google Sheet is just one more place my staff would have to copy from, so this adds a step instead of removing one.
objection: It doesn't post into Jurnal or Accurate. I'd also be sending my clients' receipts and chats to a Telegram bot I know nothing about, and I'm the one answerable to them if that goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: A direct export or import file that posts the entries straight into Jurnal or Accurate per client, so my staff stop retyping receipts.
